mood: Setting: an old European-Mediterranean city at golden hour, a long wide ancient stone stairway between pastel buildings and walls covered in green ivy and climbing roses, string lights and old lamps just starting to glow, warm low sun rays, lens flare, floating dust sparkles and rose petals in the air, VERY vivid saturated rich colours: glowing amber and peach gold sunlight, deep crimson, rose pink, emerald green ivy, turquoise sky with pink clouds, dreamy bokeh, nostalgic romantic cinematic atmosphere, intricate beautiful details.
scenes: On a pretty street of pastel pink buildings, he stands behind her and gently covers her eyes with his hand, then surprises her with a huge bouquet of red roses wrapped in kraft paper, she gasps with a big smile.
They sit side by side on the old stone stairway, each holding an open colourful vintage book up in front of the face, peeking over the books and laughing at each other.
She stands on the stone stairway taking a photo of him with a small vintage silver instant camera, one eye closed, smiling, the sun glowing behind her.
Close-up: her hand holding the small vintage instant camera, a fresh instant photo sliding out of it showing the two of them smiling, warm sunlight and bokeh.
Top-down view on old stone pavement: the big red rose bouquet in kraft paper lying on the ground with a small instant photo of the two of them beside it, rose petals around, warm sun rays.
Their two long shadows on the golden stone pavement holding hands, cast by the low sunset, rose petals blowing across the stones, their feet just at the edge of the frame.
Medium shot on the stairway: she laughs with her head thrown back and her hand on her heart, holding his arm, he smiles at her lovingly, golden light and sparkles.
Close-up of her hand with a small ring holding the sleeve of his coat, her other hand gently on his arm, warm golden light and soft bokeh, rose petals.

Sad poetic wide shot: she sits alone on the middle of the long stone stairway holding a single red rose, red petals scattered on the steps, while far up the stairs he walks away into the warm evening light, lamps glowing.

Final dreamy shot: she sits alone on the steps hugging the instant photo of the two of them to her heart with a gentle teary smile, eyes closed, and a soft glowing transparent memory of him hugging her from behind appears like golden light, rose petals and sparkles swirling, sunset sky.
